attrs.citation: Rogers, Roth, Ullman & Vadhan, Privacy Odometers and Filters: Pay-as-you-Go Composition, NeurIPS 2016
hypotheses: the budget is fixed in advance for the filter case
attrs.result: A privacy FILTER is a stopping rule that halts before a pre-specified budget is exceeded and yields a valid composition guarantee; a privacy ODOMETER reports accumulated loss without a pre-specified budget and needs a different, weaker guarantee.
